cohort: The study included 27 patients who underwent transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) for intractable postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) due to genital tract trauma (GTT) after vaginal delivery.
finding: Superselective transcatheter arterial embolization (S-TAE) was safe and significantly more effective (100% success rate) than proximal TAE (P-TAE, 67% success rate) for intractable postpartum hemorrhage due to genital tract trauma.
